question: The name given to the Indian long range, sub-sonic cruise missile that was test-fired on 15 April 2019 is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nirbhay**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nirbhay** is the name of the Indian long-range, sub-sonic cruise missile.
 
• It was test-fired on **15 April 2019**.
 
• The missile has a range of approximately **1,000 kilometers**.
 
• It is designed to carry both conventional and nuclear warheads.
 
• **Nirbhay** is developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The development of **Nirbhay** began in the early 2000s, and it has undergone several tests since then.
 
• The missile is capable of flying at low altitudes to avoid detection by radar.
 
• It enhances India's strategic capabilities and adds to the country's defense prowess.
 
• The successful test-firing of **Nirbhay** marks a significant milestone in India's defense technology development.
